Titles.eng: Does It Count If You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?
Titles.jpn: アンドロイドは経験人数に入りますか？？

Summaries.eng: Office Lady Tsuda Akane, age 28, seems like she's got it all together. Beautiful, brainy, and an indispensable office worker for a robotics manufacturer, Akane's admired at work...because her colleagues can't see her at home. Privately, Akane's a hot mess with an apartment that looks more like a landfill than a living space. Good thing she drunkenly ordered a new android named Nadeshiko to help her clean up! Well, maybe not good, because the beautiful lady android that arrives is a horny hottie. Akane's about to get more service than she expected!
Summaries.jpn:
『あたしの人生、終わりかも……』

大手電機メーカーで働く”津田あかね（28）”がうっかり酔った勢いで購入してしまったのは、所持しているだけで重罪確定！？違法製造された大人用ロマンスロイドの”撫子”だった！？撫子に翻弄されるあかねだったが、色々とハイスペックな撫子に、あかねは翻弄されつつも惹かれていき……？おひとり様OLとアンドロイド、二人（？）のウフフな同棲生活スタート！！

Aliases: Andoroido wa Keiken Ninzū ni Hairimasu ka??
Andoroido wa Keiken Ninzuu ni Hairimasu ka??
Does it Count if You Lose Your Virginity to an Android?
Does It Count If You Lose Your Innocence to an Android

Titles.jpn: あたしの人生終わりかも

Summaries.eng: Akane Tsuda (28), who works in the product planning department of a major electronics manufacturer, has a smooth career and is well-liked by her colleagues. However, her personal life is a disaster! Her room is a complete mess, and she has terrible drinking habits. In a drunken stupor, she impulsively buys a household robot. Later, what arrives at her doorstep is none other than an adult-use android named Nadeshiko...?
Summaries.jpn:
大手電機メーカーの商品企画部で働く”津田あかね（28）”は、仕事は順調で周囲からの人望も厚い一方で私生活は……壊滅的！

部屋は散らかり放題で酒癖も悪い彼女は、酔った勢いで家事用のロボットを購入してしまう。

後日、そんな彼女の元に届いたのはまさかまさかの「大人用」アンドロイド、撫子で……？

Titles.jpn: なにも大丈夫じゃない･･･

Summaries.eng: Akane sighs as she heads home earlier than usual. And no wonder—since the other day, an illegal adult robot named “Nadeshiko” has been staying at her house! Since Nadeshiko, who just arrived, doesn't have any underwear, the two head out to buy some together. Once they do, Nadeshiko goes to change in the bathroom, but she doesn't come back for a while...?
Summaries.jpn:
ため息をつきながらいつもより早く帰宅するあかね。

それもそのはず、先日より彼女の家には大人用の違法ロボット”撫子”がいるからであった！

家に来たばかりの撫子には下着がないため一緒に買いにでかける二人。

購入できたものの、トイレに着替えに行った撫子が中々戻ってこず……？

Titles.eng: The Power Switch is Inside the Mouth...!?
Titles.jpn: 電源スイッチは口の中……!?

Summaries.eng: Akane jolts awake from a nightmare where her workplace discovers she'd bought an illegal romance robot named Nadeshiko. The very source of her worries, Nadeshiko, was apparently sleeping soundly right beside her. Hmm? Come to think of it, robots don't sleep, do they? Is she out of battery? As Akane thinks this, she manages to charge Nadeshiko safely, but then she couldn't figure out how to restart her...?
Summaries.jpn:
違法ロマンスロイドの撫子を買った事が職場にバレる悪夢をみて、思わず飛び起きるあかね。

そんな悩みの元凶こと撫子はあかねの隣でスヤスヤ寝ている模様。

ん？……そういえばロボットって寝なくない？電源切れ？

そう思ったあかねは無事撫子を充電できたものの、そこから再起動の方法がわからず……？

Titles.eng: Name-Calling is Bad for the Heart!

Summaries.eng: Seeing Akane exhausted from her grueling work, Nadeshiko offers her a regular massage. Following that, Nadeshiko asks Akane to perform the “Master Authentication,” but Akane refuses the request. Master Authentication means becoming Nadeshiko's owner, but Akane says Nadeshiko feels too human to be treated like a tool. How will Nadeshiko reply when Akane tells her she wants to start as friends first...?
Summaries.jpn:
激務でお疲れのあかねを見かねて普通のマッサージをしてあげる撫子。

その流れのまま、”マスター認証”をしてとお願いする撫子に対してその申し出を断るあかね。

マスター認証はすなわち撫子の所有者になる事なのだが、それにしては撫子に人間味がありすぎて道具扱いできないと話すあかね。

そんなことでまずはお友達から始めたい、と話すあかねに撫子は……？

Titles.jpn: 撫子が高機能すぎる件について

Summaries.eng: Akane is on her way home. Troubled by how deeply she's becoming bound to Nadeshiko, unlike before, Akane feels grateful that the lights are on at her house, that someone is there waiting for her. And the one who greeted Akane upon her return was Nadeshiko... wearing nothing but an apron?
Summaries.jpn:
帰宅中のあかね。

どんどん撫子に絆されているこの状況に悩みつつも、前とは違って自分の家に明かりがついている、家に誰かが居てくれる事に感謝するあかね。

そんな形で帰宅したあかねを出迎えたのは、裸エプロン姿の撫子で……？

Titles.eng: I, Akane, will Crash the Owner Get-Together!
Titles.jpn: あかね、オーナー交流会に突撃します

Summaries.eng: Akane gets an invite to an anonymous online get-together exclusively for Romanceroid owners. Though uneasy about the anonymous email, she decides to attend, thinking it might reveal Nadeshiko's secret. What awaited Akane, filled with apprehension, was a gathering of owners dressed in fairy-tale-like animal costumes—a dog, a rabbit, a bear...?
Summaries.jpn:
ロマンスロイドオーナー限定の匿名オンライン交流会に招待されたあかね。

差出人不明のメールに不安を抱きつつも、撫子の秘密に迫れると考え参加を決意。

不安な気持ちでいっぱいのあかねの目の前で待ち構えていたのは、メルヘンなきぐるみ姿のいぬ、うさぎ、クマ姿のオーナーたちで……？

Titles.jpn: え、撫子お母さまいるの？

Summaries.eng: Akane (and Nadeshiko, who came along out of concern) stays at a leisure hotel during a business trip. While enjoying the large bath, big bed, and stylish meals unique to leisure hotels, Akane braces herself for “that sort of thing” with Nadeshiko... but nothing happened at all! Still feeling frustrated that nothing had happened, Akane drifts off to sleep, when suddenly, she hears the TV on...?
Summaries.jpn:
出張の外泊でレジャーホテルにきたあかね（と心配で連れてきた撫子）

レジャーホテル特有の大きなお風呂、大きなベッド、オシャレなご飯を満喫しつつ、

撫子との”そういうコト”も覚悟するあかねであったが……全然何もされないんだけど！？

一向になにもされないまま悶々と眠りにつくあかねであったが、突然テレビから音声が聞こえはじめ……？

Titles.jpn: 赤ちゃんじゃないもん！！！

Summaries.eng: One day after consecutive overtime shifts, Nadeshiko worries about Akane, who comes home late as usual. But before Akane could even reply, she collapses at the front door. Even though she woke up, Akane had regressed to infancy (?) due to exhaustion. Nadeshiko tries every trick in the book to nurse her back to health. However, mistaking Nadeshiko for her own mother, Akane begins acting clingy toward her...
Summaries.jpn:
残業続きのある日、いつも通り遅めに帰宅したあかねを心配する撫子であったが、そんな彼女に返事をする間もなく玄関で倒れてしまうあかね。

目覚めたは良いものの、過労がたたって幼児退行（？）してしまったあかねを看病するべくあの手この手で頑張る撫子。

そんな撫子を自分のママだと勘違いしたあかね、撫子に対して甘えはじめ……？
